title: Average influence equals noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers with $m>0$, and let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$. Choose a sign vector $z$ uniformly and a map $\pi\colon\{1,\ldots,n\}\to\{1,[0m1\ldots,m\}$ uniformly and independently. The expected average, over the input coordinates, of the uniform probability that the partitioned function $w\mapsto f((z_iw_{\pi(i)})_{i=1}^n)$ changes when one coordinate of $w$ is flipped equals the noise sensitivity of $f$ at noise rate $1/m$.
